==New Haven==

Can be obtained by baking a {{i|Raw Wild Turkey Thigh}} in {{i|Any Stove}}.

==Providence==

2x {{i|Wild Turkey Thigh}}s are received when Cutting Up a {{i|Stuffed Wild Turkey}}. Additionally a Wild Turkey Thigh can be obtained by baking a {{i|Raw Turkey Thigh}} in {{i|Any Stove}}.
